HaploBreedR: haplotype-based breeding decisions

Source: R/HaploBreedR-package.R
HaploBreedR-package.Rd

Identifies superior haplotypes at candidate genes from GWAS hits and genotype data, tests haplotype-trait associations, applies effect-size and permutation gates, and produces multi-trait breeding recommendations.

Optional parallel backend

When `n_cores > 1`, the GRM builder uses `future` and `future.apply` for parallel block computation. Install those packages if you need multi-core GRM construction; otherwise the builder runs sequentially.

Function length

The package deliberately keeps several long orchestration functions (haplobreed_analysis() and hbr_advanced_decision()) as single entry points. Splitting them would require passing dozens of intermediate objects between helpers, which increases coupling without improving readability. All internal helpers are shorter than 50 lines.
